parameters.note: Work-top width. Writing desk work surface >= 800 × 500 (GOST 13025.3-85); standard sizes unconfirmed. D-17: Dafna's own desk sizes (founder's drawings, 2026-11-16): 1100 x 600, 1500 x 700, 1700 x 700, height 750. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

Work-top depth (>= 500, GOST 13025.3-85); 600 / 700 / 800 unconfirmed. D-17: Dafna's own desk sizes (founder's drawings, 2026-11-16): 1100 x 600, 1500 x 700, 1700 x 700, height 750. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

Work-top height. EN 527-1: fixed-height desks 740 ± 20 (DESK_HEIGHT_NOT_ERGONOMIC outside, so customers can pick 1100 only with the lift frame). Lift frame: 740 sitting / 1100 standing shown to the customer (standing height unconfirmed; the frame adjusts continuously on site). D-17: Dafna's own desk sizes (founder's drawings, 2026-11-16): 1100 x 600, 1500 x 700, 1700 x 700, height 750.
Two desk types (Dafna, D-8): a board-made desk (LDSP side legs + modesty panel), or a desk on an electric height-adjustable steel frame (lift). No fixed metal legs.

D-22 (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): Dafna has no table-top boards now - the work top is a 16 / 18 mm laminated board, doubled underneath with a frame of strips (worktopFrameStripMm) and banded on the outer edges. Was: 22 / 25 mm table-top boards (up to 0.2.0).
LDSP legs and modesty panel (legs = ldsp).

worktopFrameStripMm.note: D-22 (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): width of the frame strips glued under the work top (front, back, left, right; same board). The work top edge shows two board thicknesses.

minWorkWidthMm.note: GOST 13025.3-85: writing desk work surface at least 800 × 500 mm.

minWorkDepthMm.note: GOST 13025.3-85: writing desk work surface at least 800 × 500 mm.

legDepthInsetMm.note: LDSP leg panel set back from the front and back edges of the top.

modestyHeightMm.note: Modesty panel height under the top (leaves knee room).

modestyBackInsetMm.note: Modesty panel distance from the back edge.

liftColumnMm.note: Lift-frame telescopic column section (visual; purchased frame).

frameFootInsetMm.note: Foot bar inset from the front / back edges.

frameArmHeightMm.note: Top arm under the work top (visual).

frameEndInsetMm.note: Frame column centre from the work-top ends.

constructionRules.note: D-22 CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): work top = one board (width x depth) + a frame of 4 strips under it (front / back: full width; left / right: between them), all of the top material; the outer edges are banded once over both layers (band on the top board, covers 2 x thickness). Legs / frame stand under the frame.
Work top on two LDSP side legs (full top width, flush ends) with a modesty panel between them at the back.
Lift desk: purchased electric height-adjustable steel frame: per side a foot bar, a telescopic column and a top arm; one cross beam. Drawn as boxes, not cut from board.
